name: Monterey Jack

low.description: About 1.5 oz slice or 1/3 cup shredded

siboNotes: Hard aged cheeses like Monterey Jack are naturally low in lactose and well-tolerated. The aging process reduces lactose content significantly.
preparationTips: Choose blocks over pre-shredded when possible to avoid anti-caking agents
Store properly wrapped in refrigerator to maintain freshness
Allow to come to room temperature before serving for best flavor
Pairs well in melted applications like quesadillas or grilled cheese
nutritionalHighlights: Excellent source of calcium for bone health
Contains vitamin B12 for nerve function
